description: Equilibrium constants for hydrogen isotope exchange reactions. Form: K_eq(T) = exp(a + b/T + c*ln(T)) where T in Kelvin.
source: Jones 1968; Bigeleisen 1961; Urey 1947; Souers UCRL-52628 Ch.5

H2_D2_2HD.source: Jones 1968 Table III; validated against Souers p.93

D2_T2_2DT.source: Jones 1968; estimated from HD + HT data

notes: At high temperature, all K_eq → 4.0 (statistical limit). At low T, quantum effects cause slight deviations. The 3 independent reactions fully determine equilibrium for 6 species given atom conservation.
